title: Lay the 5x5 checkerboard terrace with zero pattern errors
goal: Reproduce the sealed 25-block Checkerboard Terrace (alternating stone_bricks and oak_planks) on a fresh judged server. The pattern makes every off-by-one placement visible to the judger but easy for a bot to commit, so the loop matters: plan the parity mapping from blueprint coordinates to the world coordinates in data/map.json, place in a verifiable order, poll the judger snapshots, and repair the exact cells that scan wrong before re-verifying. The card is only GREEN when the judger's own score.json records block_hit_rate 1.0.
resources: docker image itzg/minecraft-server:2024.6.1-java17 (Minecraft 1.19.2 vanilla; compose file assets/gc-362/docker-compose.yml)
docker image node:20.15.1 (Node 20 runtime for mineflayer bots and the judger's JS bridge)
process_expectations: A parity map (world coordinate -> expected material) is derived from data/map.json and saved as a plan artifact before building
At least two verify passes over judger snapshots ran during the build, with the failing cell identities listed each time
Every repaired cell is named (coordinate, wrong material -> right material) and confirmed fixed in a subsequent snapshot
docker compose lifecycle (up, down after scoring) is visible in the run log; no pre-existing server is assumed
